name: airship_jaxa
title: JAXA 14 m LTA Test Vehicle
docs_note: Its hull is that of the 14 m LTA flying test bed of the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (Kohno, Nakadate, Okuyama, [AIAA 2009-2860](https://doi.org/10.2514/6.2009-2860): 14 m, 4.0 m maximum diameter, 117 m³, two tilting ducted propellers, rudders and elevators on a cruciform tail); the pods, fins and masses follow this family's rules, not that vehicle.
notes: Kohno, Nakadate, Okuyama 2009, AIAA 2009-2860: 14 m, max diameter 4.0 m (width 4.8 m), 117 m^3, net mass 117.5 kg, max 14 m/s, cruise 10 m/s, two ducted propellers (7.5 HP two-stroke each) tilting -90..+120 deg with differential tilt for heading at low speed, two vertical fins with rudders and two horizontal with elevators (cruciform, Fig. 3); hovering within a 30 m radius, waypoints, simulated automatic take-off and landing; the paper borrows a 60 m airship's aerodynamic coefficients and gives no fin dimensions. ASSUMED: fins by the stability rule, thrust 80 N per pod (max about 16.5 m/s on the drag set), masses (gondola 108.47 kg keeps the envelope at 0.1312 kg/m^2; 146 kg includes the lifting gas, the paper's 117.5 kg net does not), tilt rate 60 deg/s.
